fields.name: ClusterId
fields.about: The clusterId if known, this is used to validate metadata fetches prior to broker registration.

fields.name: ReplicaId
fields.about: The broker ID of the follower.

fields.name: MaxBytes
fields.about: The maximum bytes to fetch from all of the snapshots.

fields.name: Name
fields.about: The name of the topic to fetch.

fields.name: CurrentLeaderEpoch
fields.about: The current leader epoch of the partition, -1 for unknown leader epoch.

fields.name: SnapshotId
fields.about: The snapshot endOffset and epoch to fetch.

fields.name: EndOffset
fields.about: The end offset of the snapshot.

fields.name: Position
fields.about: The byte position within the snapshot to start fetching from.

fields.name: ReplicaDirectoryId
fields.about: The directory id of the follower fetching.
